verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Gitea acting as an MCP client that can load external MCP servers and use their tools. The official gitea-mcp project is an MCP server exposing Gitea to other agents, which is the opposite role and earns no credit here. A forge could plausibly ship agent features that consume MCP servers, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
